findings.description: The mirror reflection is geometrically incompatible with the foreground subject's spatial pose and handedness. In the foreground, the man holds the brush on the camera-facing side of his head (his right side) near his lower chin, whereas in the mirror reflection the brush appears on the left side of the reflected body (as in an unflipped direct camera view rather than a mirror reflection) up against his upper lip. At 00:02-00:04, the foreground man moves the brush to the side of his head above his ear and combs his hair, while his reflection simultaneously brushes his eyebrow, forehead, and the bridge of his nose.
